registry_info.name: playground_kit
registry_info.description: The playground kit: the six-point attachment ball and the two-point rod (a stick, too) of the inventory - steel in foam sleeves on a one-metre unit, snapped together into installations

playground_ball.name: Playground ball / six sockets
playground_ball.description: A foam-sleeved steel hub with a socket on each of its six faces. A rod let go with an end near a free socket snaps in and is joined; two balls a rod's length apart take a rod between them. The POINT of the inventory. Config: radius, boss, colour (pale|pink|cyan|steel), socket_reach.

playground_rod.name: Playground rod / two points
playground_rod.description: A steel core in a foam sleeve, one unit long, bare at the ends. Snaps into a ball's socket when let go near one, bridges two balls, and is a stick: hit anything faster than hit_speed and it gives the foam thwop (made in code). The LINE of the inventory. Config: length, core, sleeve, colour, hit_speed.
